name: Tlaloc
title: Rain-Maker
summary: Bring the storms of the sea to the battle and cast Ricochet bolts of energy to all enemies.
lore: One of Omeyocan’s eldest gods, the Rain-Maker has long worked to influence the natural and cosmic cycles. He wishes to more freely grant his blessings to mortals, and despite his own temper and need for blood sacrifice, he disdains those who revel in the tumult of Ryven. He collaborates with other servants of Order to calm the chaos of the post-Shattering world.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Place [ACC Up II] and [Immortal] for 2 turns on this hero before attacking.
Also increase this hero’s ATK 2% (Max 25 Stacks) for successful [Ricochet].
Enemies under Hex will always receive the extra damage.
